name: polish
description: Personal collection of curated, self-made, and adapted agent skills for prompt rewriting, defect investigation, project-wide contract exploration, domain modeling, deep-module design, frontend design quality, repository workflows, and release safety. Includes consistent-term-translation-polish-guard and prefixed Matt Pocock engineering skills.

interface.shortDescription: Curated personal skills for agent workflows
interface.longDescription: Polish is a personal collection of curated, self-made, and adapted agent skills. It includes prompt rewriting, uncertainty-first defect investigation, project-wide contract exploration, duplicate-file planning, pre-push risk review, portable frontend taste, design-system extraction, brief enhancement, shadcn/ui implementation guidance, prefixed Superpowers workflows, and prefixed Matt Pocock engineering skills (domain modeling, deep-module design, grilling, prototyping, primary-source research, two-axis code review, interactive setup wizards, and writing for agents). git-commit-message drafts and reviews messages using GitLab and GitHub conventions. consistent-term-translation-polish-guard provides English-Chinese translation and polishing with stable terminology and acronym bindings.
